messages:
lucy: Ran preflight against route-group-C with cohort=5% and override_ttl=300s; heatmap spikes on prefix eviction.

tony: ugh. paste the payload? want to see cohort shape.

lucy: payload: ```json
{
  "route": "route-group-C",
  "cohort_pct": 5,
  "override_ttl": 300
}
```

neha: short TTL + cohort fanout => churn. Proposal: soft-window semantics (apply softly for N seconds to avoid aggressive evictions), default soft_window=60s.

tony: soft-window sounds good. console should show a preflight card with projected eviction delta and a safety_score. Also disable instant force on global flags unless 2 approvers.

lucy: important: preflight must be non-mutating. implement as in-memory snapshot evaluation and emit telemetry tags preflight:true.

neha: I'll draft safety_score: weighted(eviction_rate=0.5, p99_latency=0.3, kv_hit=0.2). thresholds: >0.85 allow, 0.6-0.85 warn, <0.6 require approvers.

tony: I'll take API schema PR for /api/v1/config/preflight and add soft_window param.

ops-bot: registry: preflight-service image pushed sha=def456 to staging; smoke checks ok :white_check_mark:
